definitions.years: Continuous account carryover; yearly return starts at prior session equity; 2026 ends October 21.
definitions.rolling: 252-session inherited slices every21 sessions, 9 per candidate; not daily-start exhaustive windows.
definitions.drawdown: Drawdown within each slice includes the preceding session equity as its initial peak; actual account holdings and cash carry over.
definitions.underperformance: Strategy wealth strictly below same-cost buyhold wealth since the shared 100000 start; equality ends a run.

limitations: No new independent samples, new hard gates or account replays.
Window overlap and repeated development remain; slicing does not reset holdings or capital.
